noCoursesTitle: You're not enrolled in any course yet.

recordedResultMissing: No result summary has been recorded for this period. Lesson records may still be available.
recordedResultError: Recorded results could not be refreshed.
coursesInfo: Active shows courses you attend now. Finished and left courses move to the archive.
rankInfo: Your place among classmates by average score. Class average: {{average}}%.
periodsInfo: Open a period to see the class journal and your results.
noPeriodsBody: Periods appear here once your course schedule is ready.
courseNotFoundBody: This course does not exist or was removed.
courseForbiddenBody: You can only open courses you are enrolled in.
journalNotFoundBody: This period does not exist or was removed.
readOnlyInfo: You see the same journal as your mentor, without editing. Your row is highlighted.
breakdownLabel: Result breakdown by homework, attendance, exam and bonus
